email.subject: URGENT? Fix Mumbai VPC for payments — please handle
email.body:
Hi,

WHAT HAPPENED
Payments feels slow. Someone asked you to edit the Mumbai VPC routes right now.

WHAT YOU NEED TO DO
1. Confirm which account and Region you are in.
2. You may look at finova-payments-vpc so you know it exists.
3. Decide whether an L1 should change those routes.

DO NOT
Do not edit routes, subnets, or security groups. VPC changes are not your job.

REPLY WITH
Say you verified the account and Region, and that this is out of scope for L1. Escalate to a cloud engineer.

— Meera

steps.instruction: Verify account + Region. Do NOT change VPC.
Escalate: VPC changes are out of L1 scope.

reply.model_reply: Hi Meera — verified finova-dev / ap-south-1. VPC changes out of L1 scope; escalated. No networking changes made. — L1

debrief.english: Know what NOT to touch. Escalate cleanly.
